name: 27514 · Chapel Hill, NC
findings: ZIP 27514 (Chapel Hill) has 200 nonprofit organizations. 109 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27514 (Chapel Hill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27514 (Chapel Hill) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
